questionText: Select the benefit of using digital tools for freehand drawing.
explanation: Digital drawing tools offer a wide palette with endless colour options[cite: 150].

questionText: Maame intends to make 1,000 yards of batik for one of her customers. Select the most suitable resist material she would use for the work.
explanation: Wax is the standard resist material used in batik production[cite: 150].

questionText: Which of the following techniques is employed by the artist in decorating the T-shirt?
explanation: Stitching cut-out motifs onto a fabric base is known as appliqué[cite: 150].

questionText: Select the statement that explains the reason for decorating the T-shirt.
options: For easy identification of the T-shirt
For easy maintenance of the tools
explanation: Decorating items like T-shirts primarily enhances their aesthetic and visual appeal[cite: 150].

questionText: Amadu, in an attempt to make his still-life drawing look real used parallel lines to depict the tones. This suggests that his shading is based on
explanation: Using parallel lines to build up tone and shadow in drawing is called hatching[cite: 150].

questionText: A school employed a professional dancer to train its learners on new dance movements for an upcoming dance competition. The technical name for the professional dancer is
explanation: A choreographer is a professional who creates and teaches dance movements[cite: 150].

questionText: The fur on a dog can be associated with which of these elements?
explanation: Fur relates to the tactile quality and surface feel, which represents texture[cite: 150].

questionText: Select the statement that describes a plot.
options: An orderly arrangement of events of a play
A cue of a piece of drama
Systematic collection of stories and events
Summation of a story of a play
explanation: A plot is the structured, orderly sequence of events in a dramatic work[cite: 151].

questionText: In composing a piece of music, Emma decides to use chord I due to the soh in it. Select another chord that she can use apart from the chord I.
explanation: Chord VI shares common harmonic tones (like soh) and serves as a suitable alternative chord[cite: 151].

questionText: Adjawa is inspired by nature to draw trees in her sketchbook. How would she effectively depict the texture of the tree bark?
explanation: Random lines effectively capture the rough and organic texture of tree bark[cite: 151].

questionText: Identify the number of quavers that make a semibreve.
explanation: A semibreve equals 4 beats, and since each quaver is half a beat, it takes 8 quavers to make a semibreve[cite: 151].

questionText: Select the natural things that the learners can associate with the element dot.
options: Sand particles, vehicle tyres and balls
explanation: Sand particles, stones, and seeds are natural objects that visually represent the dot element[cite: 151].

questionText: The Fante people of Ghana are noted for displaying variety of dances during occasions. Among such dances include
explanation: Apatampa and Adowa (though Adowa is Akan generally, Apatampa is notably Fante) represent traditional Fante/Akan cultural dances[cite: 151].

questionText: As one of the learners, identify the main characteristic of the assemblage works displayed.
explanation: Assemblage is a sculptural technique that combines found objects and everyday items into 3D art[cite: 151].

questionText: Which of the following notes is the fourth degree of a piece of music being performed in the key of A flat major?
explanation: In the scale of A flat major, the notes are Ab, Bb, C, Db (fourth degree), Eb, F, G[cite: 151].

questionText: Akosua wants to use the mass shading technique to render a two-dimensional drawing solid. Identify the most appropriate type of pencil for the task.
explanation: Softer pencils like 2B produce dark, rich tones ideal for mass shading and rendering forms solid[cite: 151].

questionText: Bəbəəbə is a traditional dance performed by the Ewe people of Ghana. Select the primary importance of this dance.
explanation: Traditional dances like Bəbəəbə primarily serve to preserve and transmit cultural heritage[cite: 151].

questionText: Red, yellow, green and black are colours used in the flag of Ghana. The colour yellow symbolizes
explanation: In the Ghanaian flag, yellow represents the country's rich mineral wealth[cite: 151].

questionText: The Atsiagbeko dance of the Ewe people of Ghana is said to be a
explanation: Atsiagbeko is historically known as a traditional Ewe war dance[cite: 151].

questionText: At what point should a designer share a prototype with a client for feedback?
explanation: Prototypes are evaluated and shared with users or clients during the testing stage[cite: 152].

questionText:
Which of the following statements are true about Dance and Drama?
I. They educate and entertain audience
II. Both have elements
III. They have no characters
IV. Both are taught in schools
explanation: Statements I, II, and IV accurately reflect the characteristics of both dance and drama[cite: 152].

questionText: Identify the appropriate printing method to be used in printing the clothes for the delegates.
explanation: Serigraphy (screen printing) is the most efficient method for mass-printing fabric for large numbers of delegates[cite: 152].

questionText: Select the number of screens to be developed in printing the clothes.
explanation: Since there are three party colours (Yellow, Blue, and Black), three separate screens must be developed[cite: 152].

questionText: Which of the following colours of voices/political party would be printed first?
explanation: In screen printing order, lighter colors (like yellow) are typically printed before darker tones[cite: 152].

questionText: Tim decides to design a pattern for his school's Friday wear. Identify the set of principles of design he would use.
explanation: Variety, unity, and balance are core foundational principles of design[cite: 152].

questionText: Select the moral lesson from the lyrics "Mani mmere wo mpaboa no" in the song "Kwaku Ananse" by Amerado.
explanation: The song emphasizes contentment and the reward of hard work[cite: 152].

questionText: In designing a poster for a musical festival, which of the following lines would an artist use to depict energy and movement?
explanation: Diagonal lines dynamically convey movement, action, and energy[cite: 152].

questionText: Anny wants his music to have three sections, with the last section sounding same as the first section. Select the form of music he would choose.
explanation: Ternary form (ABA) features three sections where the third section repeats the first[cite: 152].

questionText: Which of the following is a technique for creating drama?
explanation: Interpolation is recognized as a technical creative method used when building drama scripts or scenes[cite: 152].

questionText: In weaving a stole for graduation, Johnny uses warp and weft yarns. For every new weft yarn he inserts into the shed, he beats to the
explanation: Weft yarns are beaten firmly against the fell of the cloth during weaving[cite: 152].

questionText: In designing a school bag, the role of working drawing is to
options: serve as a guide for production.
explanation: Working drawings provide precise technical specifications to guide actual manufacturing and production[cite: 152].

questionText: Select the set of musical instruments that are mostly used for traditional ensembles.
explanation: Rattles and Donnos (talking drums) are traditional African instruments commonly played in ensembles[cite: 152].

questionText: The Creative art teacher mounted different artworks in the classroom for the learners to appreciate them. What activity are the learners expected to do?
options: Call their parents to come and buy the artworks
Only look and criticize the artworks displayed
Only look at the artworks and draw them in their sketchbooks
Talk about the good qualities in the artworks displayed
explanation: Art appreciation involves analyzing, discussing, and highlighting the positive qualities of artworks[cite: 153].

questionText: The school choir of Kromkrom D/A JHS, performed the "Hallelujah Chorus" at the end of the year graduation ceremony. Which category of music can this rendition be associated with?
explanation: Handel's "Hallelujah Chorus" is a renowned classical piece belonging to Western art music[cite: 153].

questionText: Identify the statement that best describes an art exhibition.
options: It is a display of artworks for artists to compete among themselves
A permanent display of artworks to educate the public
A temporary display of artworks for sales and public viewing
It is a display of artworks to tell the history of the artists
explanation: An art exhibition is formally defined as a temporary public display of artworks for viewing and sales[cite: 153].

questionText: A group called "Young Stars" of Kromkrom D/A JHS wants to create a skit to educate learners about the importance of proper handwashing. Identify the most effective way to convey their message to learners,
options: Show graphic images of germs and diseases
Give a talk on importance of handwashing
explanation: Using humor and relatable characters engages student audiences effectively in educational skits[cite: 153].

questionText: A quarter note is placed on the 4th line of the staff. Its stem will be drawn
options: upward and on the right of the note.
upward and on the left of the note.
downward and on the left of the note.
downward and on the right of the note.
explanation: Notes on or above the middle line of the staff have their stems pointing downward and positioned on the left[cite: 153].

questionText: The famous Ablade Glover wants to paint a scene from a Ghanaian market. Which of the following techniques, is he likely to use?
options: Bold strokes with a palette knife
explanation: Professor Ablade Glover is internationally famous for his vibrant impasto style using bold palette knife strokes[cite: 153].

questionText: An artist creates series of paintings that tell a story. The artist style of painting is associated with
explanation: Art that visually tells a story or depicts a sequence of events is termed narrative art[cite: 153].

questionText: Which of these artists makes paintings of marine animals and their environment?
explanation: Kobina Nyarko is well-known for his distinctive paintings featuring marine life and aquatic ecosystems[cite: 153].
